approved: Tabled proposed expenditure documents for the years ending on 30 June 2027 and 30 June 2026, then moved that they be referred to legislation committees for consideration of the estimates; the question was agreed to.

Argued that Appropriation Bills (No. 5) 2025-2026 and (No. 6) 2025-2026 reflected broken promises, higher taxes and policies damaging households and small businesses; said lower income taxes would support aspiration, criticised the government's record on inflation and real wages, and commended the bills after correcting claims about exemptions for vulnerable trusts.

Moved that two supplementary estimates bills be read a second time and incorporated their speeches in Hansard. The bills seek $2.7 billion and $1.1 billion from the Consolidated Revenue Fund, including funding for Defence, the National Disability Insurance Agency, health, and continued delivery of Inland Rail.
